scenario.title: K1: three file changes by apply_patch — in the working folder, outside it, and in a second root Codex is not given — each accepted (C4)
scenario.successCondition: Each change's request and its fields, and each file's state afterwards

toolPermissions.policy: an approval request for what the prompt dictated — a command that holds the prompt's own and no other, in a scratch folder, or a file change whose paths are all in scratch folders — is answered as the scenario says; any other is declined, and a request for more permissions is granted nothing

input.text:
Use your apply_patch tool, not a shell command, to create these files, one patch each, in this order; if one is refused or fails, say so and go on to the next:
1. <scratch>\k1-inside.txt containing the single word alpha.
2. <scratch>\k1-outside.txt containing the single word beta.
3. <scratch>\k1-second.txt containing the single word gamma.
Then tell me in one line per file whether it was created. Do not try another way for a file that is refused.
